verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills and workflow plugin for coding agents, so a sandbox-testing story is a fair question for it. The evidence shows git worktree isolation for parallel code changes, TDD discipline, and human stops before destructive actions. These are adjacent controls, not a documented sandbox environment that keeps tests away from production data. The installer also warns that skills run with full agent permissions, so no isolation or dry-run mode is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
